_readme: One entry per funeral home id. pdf boxes are [x0, top, x1, bottom] in PDF points measured from the TOP-left of the page. text fields: at=[x, lineBottom, maxWidth]. choice options: box drawn as a circle. job: Job Card (prep) key filled only when empty. Entries with 'extends' reuse a shared form (keys starting with _) and only change template, fileTag and any fieldOverrides.
